description: This file defines a factory function to create CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) controllers for Mongoose models in an Express.js application. It includes in-memory micro-caching for list endpoints, error handling for common Mongoose errors, and methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting documents.

methods.name: microGet
methods.description: Retrieves a cached list response if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: microSet
methods.description: Stores a list response in the micro-cache with a TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError
methods.description: Maps Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP failure responses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing documents with optional pagination and caching.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single document by its MongoDB _id.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new document in the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing document by its _id.
